name: Sigmax Krea 2 conditioning tap rebalance
plain: Treats each Krea 2 text token as 12 stacked taps of 2560 values and multiplies each tap by a gain from a community profile, then rescales each sample so its overall RMS matches the input. Strength blends the gains toward 1. The classic profile boosts taps 8 to 11 by up to 5×, and subtle by up to 2×. It changes only the conditioning tensor, not the model or schedule, and the node itself says it makes no adherence claim.
math:
Symbols: c conditioning (B, S, 12·2560); g_k profile gain; s strength.
g'_k = 1 + s·(g_k − 1).
w = c ⊙ g' (per tap).
c' = w · RMS(c)/max(RMS(w), 1e−8), RMS per batch item; rows with RMS(c) = 0 are left as is.
